qualification: Public DATA framing only; not an approval, Source, signature producer or HTTP grant
encoding: Exact UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra keys or duplicate fields

fields.requestOriginal: exact retained original Auth request, UTF-8 bytes 1..16384
fields.manifestOriginal: exact canonical six-field original manifest, UTF-8 bytes 1..16384; byte-equal invocationOriginal
fields.publisherOriginal: canonical unpadded base64url of original R13, decoded bytes 1..8192
fields.signatureOriginal: canonical unpadded base64url of original public N1/index0 member, decoded bytes 1..98304
fields.actualApprovalRef: canonical lowercase UUIDv4 issued by the live Main Native approval owner; identifier alone grants nothing
fields.publisherRegistrationRef: exact original independent registered reference, UTF-8 bytes 1..256; not R13 hash
fields.publisherRevision: exact original registry revision, canonical positive uint64 decimal
fields.publisherKeyVersion: exact publisher R13 key version, canonical positive uint64 decimal; not account key version or registry revision

requiredChecks: Original peer authenticates actual same original request and Native endpoints; kind2 Auth N1 cannot stand in for kind6 member or approval
Exact request/invocation/manifest originals must match the retained request window and original purpose
Independent current registered publisher R13/ref/revision and key version must match; dual-AND verification must use original fixed ARTIFACT-RELEASE message
Actual approval current/revoke is checked by the same live Native holder bound to the original request/ref, not by any JSON approved flag
Entry availability is separate from whether the original decision remains current after its sole signing selection
Unknown send/write/signature/cleanup cannot authorize re-signing, automatic replay or a new grant
Closed/restarted holders may recover public result DATA only, never restore approval authority
Mac Source enrollment, opaque IDs, raw R13 and valid signature mathematics cannot authorize Linux HTTP control or resource lease operations
nativeIssuerAndReader: YNXOriginalArtifactReleaseApproval in original-artifact-publisher-store.h/.mm; fixed Main binding and actual visible user decision still require normal matching integration
